items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He was further influenced by Barney Kessel, Charlie Christian, Louis Armstrong and Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Do you get involved in jazz education at all?

Well just from what you’ve said and a few times I’ve done a little so called little clinics at colleges and stuff, and usually with guitarists but sometimes with whole groups and stuff, to give them some ideas for ensemble playing and things like that. So to a limited extent. Basically I mean the jazz education material that’s out there is so huge, voluminous now anyway. There’s so much stuff to study. There’s access to knowing what kind of scale to play over what chord, and everything like that, and there’s…
Do you feel the market is oversaturated with any of that? I mean there’s so much out there.
